sanskrit:
धृतराष्ट्र उवाच
धर्मक्षेत्रे कुरुक्षेत्रे समवेता युयुत्सवः।
मामकाः पाण्डवाश्चैव किमकुर्वत सञ्जय॥

translations.en: Dhritarashtra said: O Sanjaya, assembled on the holy field of Kurukshetra, desiring to fight, what did my sons and the sons of Pandu do?

sanskrit:
क्लैब्यं मा स्म गमः पार्थ नैतत्त्वय्युपपद्यते।
क्षुद्रं हृदयदौर्बल्यं त्यक्त्वोत्तिष्ठ परन्तप॥

translations.en: Do not yield to cowardice, O Arjuna. It does not become you. Shake off this weakness of heart and arise!
The contact between senses and objects gives rise to fleeting happiness and distress. They are temporary; learn to endure them.

sanskrit:
वासांसि जीर्णानि यथा विहाय नवानि गृह्णाति नरोऽपराणि।
तथा शरीराणि विहाय जीर्णान्यन्यानि संयाति नवानि देही॥

translations.en: As a person puts on new garments giving up old ones, the soul accepts new bodies giving up the old.

sanskrit:
जातस्य हि ध्रुवो मृत्युर्ध्रुवं जन्म मृतस्य च।
तस्मादपरिहार्येऽर्थे न त्वं शोचितुमर्हसि॥

translations.en: For one who has taken birth, death is certain; and for one who has died, birth is certain. You should not grieve over the inevitable.

sanskrit:
कर्मण्येवाधिकारस्ते मा फलेषु कदाचन।
मा कर्मफलहेतुर्भूर्मा ते सङ्गोऽस्त्वकर्मणि॥

translations.en: You have the right to perform your duty, but you are not entitled to the fruits of your actions.

sanskrit:
ध्यायतो विषयान्पुंसः सङ्गस्तेषूपजायते।
सङ्गात्सञ्जायते कामः कामात्क्रोधोऽभिजायते॥

translations.en: When a person dwells on sense objects, attachment arises. From attachment comes desire, and from desire comes anger.

sanskrit:
श्रेयान्स्वधर्मो विगुणः परधर्मात्स्वनुष्ठितात्।
स्वधर्मे निधनं श्रेयः परधर्मो भयावहः॥

translations.en: It is better to do your own duty imperfectly than to do another's duty perfectly.

sanskrit:
यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत।
अभ्युत्थानमधर्मस्य तदात्मानं सृजाम्यहम्॥

translations.en: Whenever there is a decline in righteousness and an increase in unrighteousness, I manifest myself on earth.

sanskrit: न हि ज्ञानेन सदृशं पवित्रमिह विद्यते।

translations.en: In this world, there is nothing as purifying as knowledge.

sanskrit:
उद्धरेदात्मनात्मानं नात्मानमवसादयेत्।
आत्मैव ह्यात्मनो बन्धुरात्मैव रिपुरात्मनः॥

translations.en: Elevate yourself by your own mind. The mind alone is your friend and the mind alone is your enemy.

sanskrit:
चञ्चलं हि मनः कृष्ण प्रमाथि बलवद्दृढम्।
तस्याहं निग्रहं मन्ये वायोरिव सुदुष्करम्॥

translations.en: The mind is restless, turbulent, strong. I consider it as difficult to control as the wind.

sanskrit:
अनन्याश्चिन्तयन्तो मां ये जनाः पर्युपासते।
तेषां नित्याभियुक्तानां योगक्षेमं वहाम्यहम्॥

translations.en: Those who worship me with undivided devotion — to them I carry what they lack and preserve what they have.
I am Time, the great destroyer of worlds.

sanskrit:
अद्वेष्टा सर्वभूतानां मैत्रः करुण एव च।
निर्ममो निरहङ्कारः समदुःखसुखः क्षमी॥

translations.en: One who is not envious, a kind friend to all, free from ego, equal in happiness and distress, and forgiving — such a devotee is dear to Me.

sanskrit:
सहजं कर्म कौन्तेय सदोषमपि न त्यजेत्।
सर्वारम्भा हि दोषेण धूमेनाग्निरिवावृताः॥

translations.en: One should not give up work born of one's nature, even if imperfect. All undertakings are covered by faults, as fire is by smoke.

sanskrit:
सर्वधर्मान्परित्यज्य मामेकं शरणं व्रज।
अहं त्वां सर्वपापेभ्यो मोक्षयिष्यामि मा शुचः॥

translations.en: Abandon all varieties of dharma and surrender unto Me. I shall deliver you from all sins. Do not fear.
